* United States [[United States Army Special Forces|Green Berets]] and [[Kurd]]ish fighters enter the city of [[Kirkuk]] in [[Iraq]] with little resistance. Turkey and U.S., in separate statements, say they will not allow the Kurds to occupy the city.,<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.washtimes.com/national/default-200341121717.htm |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030411164056/http://www.washtimes.com/national/default-200341121717.htm |archive-date=2003-04-11 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.canada.com/news/story.asp?id=45D53827-FA52-4452-9E87-7DF9276D26B9 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060717081140/http://www.canada.com/news/story.asp?id=45D53827-FA52-4452-9E87-7DF9276D26B9 |archive-date=2006-07-17 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[British Airways]] and [[Air France]] simultaneously announce that they will retire the supersonic [[Concorde]] aircraft. Passenger numbers had never recovered following a crash that killed 113 in 2000.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/uk_news/2934257.stm |title=UK &#124; Concorde grounded for good |publisher=BBC News |date=2003-04-10 |accessdate=2015-09-26}}</ref> In response, Sir [[Richard Branson]] offers to buy British Airways' Concordes for £1 for the use of his [[Virgin Atlantic Airways|Virgin Atlantic]] Airlines. BA dismisses the offer as a stunt and indicates that the planes will go to air museums.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.news24.com/News24/Finance/Companies/0,,2-8-24_1346143,00.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090109042020/http://www.news24.com/News24/Finance/Companies/0,,2-8-24_1346143,00.html |archive-date=2009-01-09 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* A fire destroys a [[boarding school]] for the deaf in [[Makhachkala]], Russia, killing 28 children, aged eight to 14. About 100 other children suffer burns and smoke inhalation, 39 of which are in serious condition.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://story.news.yahoo.com/news?tmpl=story&u=%2Fap%2F20030410%2Fap_on_re_eu%2Frussia_school_fire&cid=518&ncid=716 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2019-07-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041114183255/http://story.news.yahoo.com/news?tmpl=story&u=%2Fap%2F20030410%2Fap_on_re_eu%2Frussia_school_fire&cid=518&ncid=716 |archive-date=2004-11-14 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
